versions.changelog: Ownership migrated to the trustgrowth org; content unchanged from 1.0.0

Initial release of competitor-readout skill.

- Provides periodic competitor digests, highlighting tracked competitor changes and identifying content gaps.
- Fetches and compares competitor pages using open sources or TrustGrowth APIs; supports local and Wayback Machine diffs.
- Clearly separates unchanged competitors (single line) from those with observed updates (detailed section).
- Labels findings as Measured, User-provided, or Estimated; clearly names all estimators for third-party data.
- Encourages evidence-based, ethical reporting in line with Groundcrew doctrine.
- Guidance included for when to use alternate skills for tracking setup, gap actions, or claim-safe reporting.
